title: [DREAMER] Replace console.error with proper logger in git validation
overview:
Direct console usage bypasses the logging infrastructure, making it difficult to control log levels and outputs in production environments. This creates inconsistency in how debugging information is surfaced.

**Motivation:** Using the centralized Logger provides consistent log formatting, level control, and output routing. It also enables better debugging experiences in production by allowing log configuration without code changes.

**Success criteria:**
- console.error calls replaced with logger.debug
- DEBUG_IS_GIT_REPO environment variable behavior is preserved
- Logging tests pass
- No regression in git repository detection functionality

**Technical constraints:**
- Must preserve debug-only behavior when DEBUG_IS_GIT_REPO is not set
- Logger instance must be properly injected or imported
- Should not add performance overhead when debug is disabled

**In scope:**
- src/git/validation.ts - lines 194 and 214
**Out of scope:**
- Other console.log/error usage in the codebase (separate issue)

**Signals:** priority: low, urgency: Code quality improvement
